annotation.title_clean: Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
annotation.title_en: Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, AI Act Service Desk
annotation.summary_en: Official EU AI Act Service Desk page outlining the phased application timeline of the AI Act through 2 August 2028, reflecting amendments from the Digital Omnibus on AI. It covers prohibitions, general-purpose AI rules, transparency, sandboxes, and high-risk rules including those for AI embedded in regulated products.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Act applies progressively, with full roll-out of main milestones by 2 August 2028.
Prohibitions and AI literacy apply first; GPAI obligations and governance bodies follow.
Article 50 transparency rules and enforcement begin in the main application phase.
New prohibitions on non-consensual sexual deepfakes and CSAM-generating AI systems.
High-risk rules for Annex III and for AI in Annex I regulated products apply later, as amended by the Digital Omnibus.
